card.line: Aphek, meaning "strength," is the name of several towns in Bible lands. Some were places where the Philistines gathered and where Israel fought the Arameans.

moments.title: Philistines camp at Aphek
moments.text: The Israelites camped at Ebenezer while the Philistines camped at Aphek. Then the battle began.

moments.title: Philistines gather forces
moments.text: The Philistines brought all their forces together at Aphek, while Israel camped by the spring in Jezreel.

moments.title: Victory over the Arameans
moments.text: Ben-hadad led the Arameans up to Aphek to fight Israel. The LORD gave Israel the victory, and a wall fell on twenty-seven thousand of the men who fled into the city.

moments.title: Elisha's promise of victory
moments.text: Elisha had the king of Israel shoot an arrow from the east window. He said it was the LORD's arrow of victory, and Israel would strike the Arameans in Aphek.
